synthetic_model.description: Zero-intelligence order flow: Poisson limit and market order arrivals per side, exponential cancellation of each resting order, limit prices placed 1-10 ticks from the opposite best quote with P(d) proportional to d^-0.5.
synthetic_model.seeds: 0-19 for the study; 1000-1002 used only for no-event calibration

real_data_outcome: Attempted 2026-09-28. The former direct-download sample URLs now return the site's web app instead of data; samples are provided only through a trial-account application reviewed by LOBSTER staff. No real data was downloaded or used.
real_data_scope_and_limitations: None applicable: no real data is used anywhere in this repository. No result here should be read as describing a real market, instrument, date or venue.
supports_research_question: The synthetic data supports a controlled methodology demonstration of how this model's liquidity responds to a designed stress scenario, and of how fill assumptions change measured execution quality within this model. It does not support claims about real markets.
